research_question: When does relational information add predictive value beyond strong entity-local and relational baselines in public health/regulatory ML?

maude.target: product/problem-code relation first observed in a retained quarter
maude.observation_cutoff: history contains only quarters strictly before the scored quarter
maude.candidate_generation: problem code observed globally before q, product has a prior report, and product/problem edge absent before q
maude.feature_availability: prior product reports, prior relations, prior manufacturers, prior problem hierarchy, and prior four-quarter activity only
maude.negative_label: candidate not observed for the product in q; temporal non-observation, not proof of no underlying failure
leakage_rules: score before adding the current quarter to history
fit learned rankers only at frozen refit quarters using prior rows
rank all eligible candidate problems rather than sampled negatives
positive means first observed in the retained collection window, not first ever

cms_nursing.target: serious G-L Health deficiency at the target Health Standard inspection
cms_nursing.observation_cutoff: facility history and CHOW counts are strictly prior to target inspection; ownership association is active at the target date
cms_nursing.candidate_generation: all retained Health Standard inspection episodes with at least one prior Health Standard inspection
cms_nursing.feature_availability: prior inspection outcomes, prior 365/730-day windows, facility age/state, prior CHOW events, and active historical ownership-network aggregates
cms_nursing.negative_label: no observed Standard Deficiency with Scope Severity Code G-L at target episode; not evidence of safety
leakage_rules: exclude the target inspection from all facility history counts
use expanding training rows ending before each target year
do not use target labels when constructing owner or peer features
use complete CHOW owner snapshot and restrict historical identifiers to provider CCNs

status: benchmark-development; existing 2023-2025 results have been inspected and are exploratory
